instruction: Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Design a system that uses a 6-to-1 priority encoder and a 64-bit shift register to implement a pseudo-random number generator (PRNG) based on a linear feedback shift register (LFSR) algorithm. The 6-to-1 priority encoder should be designed using combinational logic, with a 3-bit input for selecting the input data and 4-bit inputs for the 6 input data. If the selection input is greater than 5, then the output should be set to 0. The 64-bit shift register should have a feedback loop that feeds back the XOR of certain bits in the register to the input. The feedback should be generated by a logic function based on the LFSR algorithm. The output of the shift register should be used as the output of the PRNG module, which should output a 64-bit binary number.
